projectTitle: ReefBond: A Mussel-Inspired Bioadhesive for Coral Reef Restoration
projectTitle_zh: ReefBond：一款用於珊瑚礁復育的仿貽貝生物黏著劑
tagline: A mussel-inspired protein material, designed to help coral fragments hold on while they establish a new home.
tagline_zh: 一種受貽貝啟發的蛋白質材料，設計目的是讓珊瑚斷枝在建立新家的期間能夠附著得住。
summary: GYHS (Guangdong Guangya High School, Guangzhou) built ReefBond, a recombinant fusion protein that joins a mussel foot protein adhesion module (Mfp3-v12 / Mfp3-v15) to an acidic mineralization module (a CARP3-derived peptide, (Asp)8, (DE)6 or (DDE)4) so that surface adhesion and interfacial mineral deposition act at the same coral-substrate interface. Eight fusion designs were expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) from pET21a; the team reports qualitative surface-retention staining, in vitro CaCO3 deposition with SEM imaging, and a purpose-built two-version underwater test tank with a motor-guided force gauge, five-level wave generator and a six-channel monitoring interface. The project is unusually honest: nearly every claim is paired with what has not yet been measured, and no live-coral test has been done. Human Practices is the spine of the project rather than a decoration - expert and practitioner advice visibly reorders the experimental programme.
summary_zh: GYHS（廣東廣雅中學，廣州）打造了 ReefBond，一種重組融合蛋白，把貽貝足蛋白的黏附模組（Mfp3-v12 / Mfp3-v15）與一個酸性礦化模組（源自 CARP3 的胜肽、(Asp)8、(DE)6 或 (DDE)4）接在一起，使表面黏附與界面礦物沉積作用於同一個珊瑚與基質的界面上。八種融合設計以 pET21a 在 E. coli BL21(DE3) 中表現；團隊回報了定性的表面滯留染色、搭配 SEM 影像的體外 CaCO3 沉積，以及一座自行打造、做了兩個版本的水下測試水槽，具備馬達導引的測力計、五段式造波器與六通道監測介面。這個專案誠實得不尋常：幾乎每一項主張都同時列出還沒量到什麼，而且完全沒有做過活體珊瑚測試。人類實踐是整個專案的骨幹而不是裝飾，專家與實務工作者的建議明顯重排了實驗計畫的順序。

dry.frameworks: No computational modelling framework. The Model and Software template pages are essentially unfilled iGEM boilerplate; the dry-lab contribution is the instrumentation and data-recording software for the hardware platform, plus a literature-based mechanistic review (Venn 2011, Mass 2013, Cornwall 2021, Lange 2024, Gavriel 2018, Laipnik 2020) used in place of simulation.
dry.frameworks_zh: 沒有運算建模框架。Model 與 Software 兩個頁面基本上仍是未填寫的 iGEM 範本樣板；乾實驗的貢獻是硬體平台的儀器與資料記錄軟體，再加上一份基於文獻的機制回顧（Venn 2011、Mass 2013、Cornwall 2021、Lange 2024、Gavriel 2018、Laipnik 2020），用以替代模擬。
dry.dataviz: ReefBond monitor renders live time-series charts for six channels (electrical conductivity, water temperature, total dissolved solids, salinity, pH and a raw light-sensor ADC value), a recent-image gallery and time-lapse playback; records are written about once per second and plots refresh about every two seconds.
dry.dataviz_zh: ReefBond monitor 會即時繪製六個通道的時間序列圖（導電度、水溫、總溶解固體、鹽度、pH，以及光感測器的原始 ADC 值），另有近期影像圖庫與縮時播放；紀錄大約每秒寫入一次，圖表大約每兩秒更新一次。
dry.datascience: Record discipline rather than analysis: readings and the manually selected wave level are written to CSV with timestamps, a channel is left blank after more than 6 s without a reading while a measured zero is kept as zero, and the team insists raw ADC and ppm values are not relabelled as lux/PAR or PSU without calibration. Planned work is to key sensor CSVs, photographs and mechanical test sheets to shared experiment and sample identifiers.
dry.datascience_zh: 這裡的重點是記錄紀律而不是分析：讀值與手動選定的造波段位會連同時間戳寫入 CSV，某個通道若超過 6 秒沒有讀值即留空，而真正量到的零值則保留為零；團隊並堅持未經校正的原始 ADC 與 ppm 值不得被改標成 lux/PAR 或 PSU。計畫中的工作是把感測器 CSV、照片與機械測試表單以共用的實驗與樣本識別碼串接起來。
dry.software: ReefBond monitor - a browser-based acquisition and recording interface for the underwater test platform (device status, six environmental channels, scheduled photography at 5-86,400 s intervals, time-lapse, CSV export). Published at https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/gyhs/reefbondmonitor .
dry.software_zh: ReefBond monitor，一個供水下測試平台使用、在瀏覽器中執行的擷取與記錄介面（裝置狀態、六個環境通道、間隔 5 至 86,400 秒的定時拍照、縮時影片、CSV 匯出）。發布於 https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/gyhs/reefbondmonitor 。
stack: analogue pH module (A1) and light sensor (A0)
techniques: instrument calibration planning (two-point pH conversion, comparison against reference instruments)
Coomassie Brilliant Blue surface-retention staining and NBT reactivity staining
digital force-gauge pull testing with guide-rail loading
in vitro CaCO3 deposition (10 mM CaCl2, 25 mM MgCl2, 10 mM NaHCO3, 25 C, 7 d)

good.publicEngagement: A school club exhibition with a Chinese-language 'SAVE CORAL REEF' poster, a knowledge quiz with small prizes and whiteboard questions introduced coral biology, reef ecology, threats and existing restoration methods before explaining ReefBond; students and teachers read the displays and talked with the team. Social media extended this, with post-level viewing records of 1,489 views for the iGEM introduction and 679 for the coral-themed post. The strongest element is a published set of six quiz questions and answers written specifically to kill misconceptions the team had encountered - corals are animals, bleaching is not death, an acidic module is a design hypothesis and not proof of increased coral calcification, engineered bacteria stay in the lab. The team states plainly that it has evidence of participation (photos, view counts) but not of learning, and sets out the paired anonymous pre/post records it will collect next.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 一場校內社團展覽，搭配中文的「SAVE CORAL REEF」海報，以及附小獎品的知識問答與白板提問，在介紹 ReefBond 之前先帶入珊瑚生物學、礁區生態、威脅與既有的復育方法；學生與老師閱讀展板並與團隊交談。社群媒體延伸了這項工作，並有逐篇的觀看紀錄，iGEM 介紹文為 1,489 次觀看，珊瑚主題文為 679 次。最強的部分是一組公開的六題問答，專為擊破團隊實際遇過的迷思而寫，包括珊瑚是動物、白化不等於死亡、酸性模組只是一個設計假說而不是珊瑚鈣化增加的證據、工程菌只留在實驗室內。團隊明白表示自己有參與的證據（照片、觀看次數），但沒有學習成效的證據，並列出下一步要蒐集的匿名配對前後測紀錄。
good.ihp: The causal chain is explicit and runs through five strands. A field visit to the Guangdong Marine Science Education Base with Professor Xie (Shenzhen Research Institute, Guangdong Ocean University) and the coral husbandry and restoration staff produced the first redirection: Xie explained that the facility's existing modified mortar already wins on cost and underwater handling but needs surface cleaning, and recommended testing underwater setting time, substrate differences, resistance to water movement and temperature stability - so the team replaced 'bond strength' with a seven-part requirement set (working and setting time, substrate compatibility, disturbance resistance, stable positioning, durability, cost, effects on coral and water quality) and adopted a staged validation pathway starting in ornamental reef aquaria rather than the sea. Yusong Shi, a Westlake University doctoral student and stony-coral hobbyist, turned handling into structure: his insistence on minimising handling disturbance produced the V2 fixed base, screw-in detachable holders and recessed model interfaces, and his suggestion of an ointment-style tube became the roughly 0.5 g single-use small-dose packaging concept. The sharpest change came from four experts converging against the team's own favourite module - Xie doubted their equipment could measure coral calcification rates, Shi recommended simpler mineralization work, Professor Baowei Chen (School of Marine Sciences, Sun Yat-sen University) told them not to interpret external deposition as stimulation of coral metabolism, and Professor Wang (South China University of Technology) prioritised adhesion because mineralization tests are more demanding; instead of dropping or defending the module, the team rewrote its research question to 'does a candidate mineralization module change in vitro deposition, and can that change measurably affect attachment performance?', reinterpreted mineralization as material-interface deposition and kept only comparative screening of the four acidic peptide classes. Professor Wang's point that microbes will use the protein and raise local oxygen demand added aeration, dissolved-oxygen and coral-microbiome questions to the assessment plan, while Professor Xu (College of Environmental and Resource Sciences, Zhejiang University) converted 'did mineral form?' into a method - indirect turbidity and TDS monitoring followed by SEM of endpoint samples - which is why TDS recording and a turbidity meter were added to V2. A peer, Student Chen of Guangdong Guangya High School with internship experience at a South China Sea coral facility, asked how long ReefBond would hold and what failure would mean, which pushed the team from a single tensile number to attachment service life, reapplication after failure and pollution burden. Professor Chen's separation of composition, dose, release, bioavailability and the distinction between functional aging and biodegradation became a six-dimension safety endpoint framework (composition and residues; exposure; degradation; water quality and microbes; deposit contact; organism selection), and the team then read Chinese Biosecurity Law Articles 35-38 and environmental-code Articles 95 and 737-738 against their own plan. They state clearly that no regulatory consultation has yet happened and no live coral has been tested - the honesty is itself part of the method.
good.ihp_zh: 因果鏈清楚可見，並沿五條線索展開。一次與謝教授（廣東海洋大學深圳研究院）以及珊瑚養護與復育人員同行的廣東海洋科學教育基地實地參訪，帶來了第一次方向修正：謝教授說明該場域現用的改質砂漿在成本與水下操作性上已經勝出，但需要清理表面，並建議測試水下凝結時間、不同基質的差異、抗水流擾動能力與溫度穩定性；於是團隊把「黏結強度」換成一組七項要求（可操作時間與凝結時間、基質相容性、抗擾動性、定位穩定性、耐久性、成本，以及對珊瑚與水質的影響），並採用一條分階段的驗證路徑，從觀賞性珊瑚缸開始而不是直接下海。西湖大學博士生、同時是石珊瑚愛好者的 Yusong Shi 把操作性轉成了結構：他堅持要把操作擾動降到最低，催生出 V2 的固定底座、可旋入拆卸的夾持件與內凹式的模型接合介面，而他提出的藥膏式軟管建議，則變成約 0.5 g 的單次使用小劑量包裝構想。最關鍵的改變來自四位專家一致對著團隊自己最喜歡的那個模組開火：謝教授懷疑他們的設備量不出珊瑚的鈣化速率，Shi 建議把礦化工作做得更簡單，陳寶威教授（中山大學海洋科學學院）告訴他們不要把外部沉積解讀為對珊瑚代謝的刺激，而王教授（華南理工大學）則認為應優先做黏附，因為礦化測試的要求更高；團隊沒有砍掉這個模組，也沒有為它辯護，而是把研究問題改寫為「某個候選礦化模組是否會改變體外沉積，而這個改變是否能在附著表現上造成可量測的差異？」，把礦化重新解釋為材料界面上的沉積，並只保留對四類酸性胜肽的比較性篩選。王教授指出微生物會利用這個蛋白質並提高局部需氧量，這使曝氣、溶氧與珊瑚微生物相的問題被加入評估計畫；而徐教授（浙江大學環境與資源學院）把「到底有沒有形成礦物？」轉換成一套方法，也就是先間接監測濁度與 TDS、再對終點樣本做 SEM，這正是 V2 加入 TDS 記錄與濁度計的原因。一位同儕，廣東廣雅中學的陳同學，曾在南海一處珊瑚場域實習，他問 ReefBond 能撐多久、失效會造成什麼後果，這把團隊從單一的拉伸數值推向附著使用壽命、失效後重新施用與污染負荷。陳教授把成分、劑量、釋放、生物可利用性區分開來，並區分功能性老化與生物降解，這些成為一個六構面的安全性終點框架（成分與殘留；暴露；降解；水質與微生物；沉積物接觸；生物選擇），團隊接著也對照自己的計畫研讀了中國《生物安全法》第 35 至 38 條以及環境法規第 95 條與第 737 至 738 條。他們明白表示目前尚未進行任何法規諮詢，也還沒測試過活體珊瑚，而這份誠實本身就是方法的一部分。
good.realWorld: Need is framed with cited numbers rather than slogans: reefs are about 0.2% of the seafloor but support at least 25% of marine species, NOAA recorded bleaching-level heat stress over roughly 84.4% of global reef area in 2023-2025, and a review of historical restoration cases found 60-70% survival for common genera but a median restored area of only 100 m2 monitored for 12 months - which is why the team targets the early post-transplant attachment window rather than restoration as a whole. Four SDGs are claimed with named sub-targets and justification: 14.2 (attachment material for ecosystem restoration), 14.a (the open hardware, operating instructions and published software as marine research-capacity and knowledge transfer), 12.4 and 12.5 (composition, release, degradation and a proposed metric of material consumed per acceptable attachment over a defined period, including reapplication after failure), 9.5 and 9.4 (traceable development and testing capacity), and 11.4 (conservation practice and engagement); SDG 13 is explicitly held as indirect rather than counted. Deployment follows an evidence-gated pathway - laboratory production and functional testing, then functional and safety assessment in aquaria or nurseries, then carefully planned marine trials - with Xie's warning that cost could block large-scale restoration kept on the page. The regulatory path is named but unstarted: teachers and the partner institution will compile composition, residue, dose, release and site information for internal review before consulting local environmental, natural resources and fisheries authorities and the site manager about approvals, filings, organism sources, site use and monitoring. Cost is treated as full accounting - preparation and application losses, replacement, tool reuse, equipment cost, training and maintenance - and after the Jamboree the plan is calibration and repeatability testing of the platform, matched-control comparisons of fusion proteins against the adhesive component and commercial materials, staged safety assessment, aquarium user trials of dispensing and positioning, and returning the data to Professor Xie, Shi and Student Chen to ask whether their concerns were actually answered, recording the reasons for each decision including when results show no improvement.
good.realWorld_zh: 需求是以引用的數字而非口號架起來的：珊瑚礁約佔海床的 0.2%，卻支撐至少 25% 的海洋物種；NOAA 記錄到 2023 至 2025 年間全球約 84.4% 的珊瑚礁面積承受達白化程度的熱壓力；而一份回顧歷史復育案例的研究發現，常見屬別的存活率為 60 至 70%，但復育面積中位數僅 100 m2、監測期僅 12 個月。這正是團隊把目標放在移植後早期的附著關鍵期，而不是整個復育工作的原因。他們主張對應四項 SDG，並列出具名子目標與理由：14.2（用於生態系復育的附著材料）、14.a（開源硬體、操作說明與公開軟體作為海洋研究能力與知識移轉）、12.4 與 12.5（成分、釋放、降解，以及一項提議的指標，即在一段界定期間內達成每一次可接受附著所消耗的材料量，並含失效後重新施用）、9.5 與 9.4（可追溯的開發與測試能力），以及 11.4（保育實務與公眾參與）；SDG 13 則明確被列為間接而不予計入。部署遵循一條以證據為關卡的路徑，先是實驗室製備與功能測試，再是在水族缸或苗圃中的功能與安全評估，最後才是經仔細規劃的海域試驗，而謝教授關於成本可能阻礙大規模復育的提醒也留在頁面上。法規路徑有被指名但尚未啟動：老師與合作機構將彙整成分、殘留、劑量、釋放與場址資訊供內部審查，之後再就許可、備查、生物來源、場址使用與監測事宜，諮詢當地的環保、自然資源與漁業主管機關以及場址管理者。成本以完整會計的方式處理，包含配製與施用損耗、重新施作、工具重複使用、設備成本、訓練與維護；Jamboree 之後的計畫則是平台的校正與重複性測試、融合蛋白對黏附元件與商用材料的配對對照比較、分階段的安全評估、在水族缸中由使用者實測擠出與定位，以及把資料帶回給謝教授、Shi 與陳同學，問他們當初的疑慮是否真的得到回答，並記錄每一個決定的理由，包括結果顯示沒有改善的那些情形。

gemsTakeaway: Adopt GYHS's habit of letting stakeholders attack the module you are most attached to and then rewriting the research question instead of the conclusion: four experts doubted their mineralization story, so the team reinterpreted it as interfacial deposition and kept only a controlled comparative screen. Pair it with their discipline of printing, beside every result, the measurement that would be needed to make the claim and has not yet been made.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 學 GYHS 的習慣：讓利害關係人去攻擊你最捨不得的那個模組，然後改寫研究問題，而不是改寫結論。四位專家都質疑他們的礦化論述，於是團隊把它重新解釋為界面沉積，只保留一項受控的比較性篩選。再搭配他們的另一項紀律：在每一項結果旁邊，都寫出要讓那個主張成立所需、但目前還沒做的量測。
